component.name: Aux Proton Drive Bridge
component.summary: Sync and manage Proton Drive on the Linux desktop

description.p: Aux Proton Drive Bridge is an unofficial Linux desktop app for Proton Drive, built on top of Proton's official proton-drive command-line client. It gives Proton Drive users on Linux the sync client Proton does not ship yet.

ul.li: Browse, upload, and download files in your Proton Drive
Background sync in four modes: conservative, one-way upload, one-way download, and bidirectional
Selective sync with exclude patterns that fence both upload and download
Conflict detection with safe, reviewable resolution
Transfer queue with pause, resume, and cancel, plus persistent transfer history
One-way backup profiles for scheduled folder backups
System tray operation and file-manager integration
Signed releases with an in-app updater

description.p: This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Proton AG. It drives the official Proton Drive CLI, so your credentials stay with Proton's own tooling.
Shutdown and sync-correctness pass: reliable quit on Linux, single-instance upload deduplication, and selective-sync exclude patterns that now fence downloads as well as uploads.
Reliability and release-hardening pass across transfers, sync integrity, and the in-app updater.
